headline: Alkali Metals submits EGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Resolutions pass at Alkali Metals EGM

modes.bear: Merely a procedural compliance update with no bearing on near-term earnings or growth.

summary: Alkali Metals Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 13, 2026, to the stock exchanges. headline: Alkali Metals schedules extraordinary general meeting for November 13, 2026
